const.name: Magic
const.doc: 'ABTB' read as little endian u32: the region is an Artemis bridge.

const.name: MaxPlayers
const.doc: Players of a match (Common.Engine k_MaxPlayers) and action slots, by player table index.

const.name: MaxEntities
const.doc: Live objects of a tick (Common.Engine k_MaxObjects).

const.name: TickBuffers
const.doc: Tick buffers: Artemis writes the one Python is not reading.

const.name: MaxObjectives
const.doc: Flags, and stands, a tick carries (a capture game has one of each per team: Common.Engine k_MaxTeams).

const.name: MaxWeapons
const.doc: Live weapons a tick carries: in hand, on the floor or mounted (D254).

const.name: MaxExplosives
const.doc: Live explosives a tick carries: fusion coils, land mines, plasma batteries, propane tanks (D259).

const.name: MaxLifts
const.doc: Live lifts a tick carries: man cannons and gravity lifts (D261).

const.name: MaxLiftStages
const.doc: Stages (phantom types that push players or bipeds) a lift carries. The tags have 3 at most (D261).

const.name: MaxTeams
const.doc: Teams of a match (Common.Engine k_MaxTeams): the length of the team score arrays.

const.name: PowerupCount
const.doc: Powerups of a game variant (red, blue, yellow): the length of the powerup duration array.

const.name: PresetNameSize
const.doc: Bytes of a gametype preset name, with its end zero (Engine.Base.Preset k_MaxPresetNameLength is 31).

const.name: MaxTickEvents
const.doc: Newest events of the match a tick carries (D141). Python keeps its cursor by Sequence.

const.name: NotLocal
const.doc: LocalIndex of a player that is not local.

string.name: RegionPrefix
string.doc: Name of the region: prefix + pid of MCC (D136).

string.name: TickEventSuffix
string.doc: Auto-reset event Artemis sets after it publishes a tick.

string.name: ActionEventSuffix
string.doc: Auto-reset event Python sets after it publishes the actions of a decision.

string.name: DiscoveryFolder
string.doc: Folder inside %LOCALAPPDATA%\Artemis with one pid.json per open region.

enum.name: BridgeOwner
enum.doc: Who controls the scale and the players of the AgentMask (D106).

enum.name: BridgeMode
enum.doc: Whether the game waits for the actions (D105).

value.name: Free
value.doc: Never waits. A late decision is applied when it arrives and counted.

value.name: Lockstep
value.doc: The tick of a decision plus the latency waits for its actions, with a cap.

enum.name: BridgePhase
enum.doc: State of the engine as Artemis sees it.

value.name: Idle
value.doc: No match: menus, lobby or teardown.

value.name: Running
value.doc: Ticks are running and decision ticks are published.

enum.name: BridgePresetResult
enum.doc: What became of the last RequestPreset (Q97).

value.name: Pending
value.doc: Taken and waiting for a round break of the match.

value.name: Applied
value.doc: Written into the live variant between rounds and read back equal.

value.name: AtLoad
value.doc: Taken in the lobby: the next start writes it.

value.name: Rejected
value.doc: Not applied: the preset changes what only a load can change, a trait set the script lacks, or its files are wrong. The variant and the active preset did not change.

value.name: Unknown
value.doc: A result this layout does not name.

enum.name: BridgeGround
enum.doc: What the feet of a biped touch (Perception GroundKind, D260).

value.name: Object
value.doc: A living object, such as a forge block or a vehicle.

value.name: Attached
value.doc: Parented to another object, such as a seat.

enum.name: BridgeInfiniteAmmo
enum.doc: Infinite ammo trait (Blam.Layout InfiniteAmmoMode, D262). 0 is a value outside the table.

enum.name: BridgeAbilityUsage
enum.doc: Armor ability usage trait (Blam.Layout AbilityUsageMode, D262).

enum.name: BridgeIdentityVisibility
enum.doc: Who sees the waypoint or the name of a player (Blam.Layout IdentityVisibility, D262).

enum.name: BridgeRadarMode
enum.doc: Motion tracker mode trait (Blam.Layout RadarDisplayMode, D262).

enum.name: BridgePowerup
enum.doc: Custom powerup the engine applies to a player (Common Semantic Subtype Powerup, D263).

flags.name: BridgeRequest
flags.doc: One-shot client requests of a decision (D120).

bit.name: EntitiesTruncated
bit.doc: The tick had more live objects than MaxEntities.

bit.name: ObjectivesTruncated
bit.doc: The tick had more flags or more stands than MaxObjectives.

bit.name: WeaponsTruncated
bit.doc: The tick had more live weapons than MaxWeapons.

bit.name: ProjectilesTruncated
bit.doc: The tick had more live projectiles than MaxProjectiles.

bit.name: ExplosivesTruncated
bit.doc: The tick had more live explosives than MaxExplosives.

bit.name: LiftsTruncated
bit.doc: The tick had more live lifts than MaxLifts.

struct.name: BridgeVec3
struct.doc: Vector of three floats, world units or a direction.

struct.name: BridgeArtemisControl
struct.doc: Part of the control block written by Artemis only.

field.name: Heartbeat
field.doc: Counter Artemis raises about every 50 ms while it is loaded.

field.name: QpcFrequency
field.doc: Ticks per second of QueryPerformanceCounter (PublishQpc).

field.name: Owner
field.doc: Effective owner.

field.name: Mode
field.doc: Effective mode.

field.name: DecisionPeriod
field.doc: Effective N: a published tick every N action ticks (D114).

field.name: Latency
field.doc: Effective d: a decision is applied d action ticks after its decision tick.

field.name: IsPaused
field.doc: Whether the logic ticks are held (D143): frames run without ticks, the Lockstep wait has no cap.

field.name: MatchId
field.doc: Engine starts since Artemis loaded. Changes with every match.

field.name: ActionTick
field.doc: Last action tick applied by the engine (the clock of the bridge).

field.name: Scale
field.doc: Requested time scale in effect (0 = the engine default).

field.name: ActiveBuffer
field.doc: Tick buffer with the last published tick.

field.name: PublishedTicks
field.doc: Ticks published since Artemis loaded.

field.name: LateActions
field.doc: Free mode: decisions applied after their tick plus the latency.

field.name: LockstepWaits
field.doc: Ticks the game waited for a decision.

field.name: LockstepWaitNs
field.doc: Total time the game waited for decisions.

field.name: LockstepTimeouts
field.doc: Waits that hit the cap (the previous decision was kept).

field.name: HandleMismatches
field.doc: Actions dropped because their handle is not the player of the slot.

field.name: RejectedActions
field.doc: Actions with values out of range (fixed before use).

field.name: ClockSkips
field.doc: Ticks read where the action tick did not advance by exactly one (must stay 0). The restart of each match is not one.

field.name: LockstepWaitMaxNs
field.doc: Longest wait for a decision outside a pause.

field.name: FlattenNs
field.doc: Total time spent flattening and publishing ticks (PublishedTicks of them).

field.name: FlattenMaxNs
field.doc: Longest flatten and publish of one tick.

field.name: PausedFrames
field.doc: Game frames that ran without ticks because of a pause.

field.name: EndRoundSequence
field.doc: Last RequestEndRound seen (D144). Seen is not done: dropped without Python owning the instance or a match running. The proof is the RoundEnd or GameOver event.

field.name: PresetSequence
field.doc: Last RequestPreset seen (Q97). PresetResult answers it: Pending until the round break, then Applied or Rejected.

field.name: ActivePreset
field.doc: Name of the active gametype preset, zero filled. Empty when none.

struct.name: BridgeClientControl
struct.doc: Part of the control block written by Python only.

field.name: RequestPeriod
field.doc: N wanted, 1 to 60 (0 = keep).

field.name: RequestLatency
field.doc: d wanted, 1 to N (0 = keep).

field.name: RequestScale
field.doc: Time scale wanted while Python owns the instance (0 = the engine default).

field.name: RequestPause
field.doc: 1 holds the logic ticks while Python owns the instance (D143). Set it before a long step.

field.name: AgentMask
field.doc: Player table indices Python controls, one bit each.

field.name: RequestEndRound
field.doc: Counter: a raise ends the round, as the end_round action of Megalo (D144). Raises before Artemis takes one count as one. Starts from EndRoundSequence.

field.name: RequestPreset
field.doc: Counter: a raise asks for the preset RequestPresetName, or none when it is empty (Q97). Taken only while Python owns the instance. Starts from PresetSequence.

field.name: RequestPresetName
field.doc: Name of the preset wanted, zero filled. Written before the counter is raised.

field.name: RequestTurnLimit
field.doc: Most radians the yaw and the pitch of each agent turn per tick toward those of its action (D114). 0 = straight to them.

field.name: ClientHeartbeat
field.doc: Counter Python raises at least every 500 ms.

field.name: ActionSequence
field.doc: Action tick of the last decision whose actions are complete. Written last.

struct.name: BridgeControl
struct.doc: Control block at the start of the region.

struct.name: BridgeTickHeader
struct.doc: What the tick is: which match and which action tick.

field.name: ActionTick
field.doc: Action tick of the state of the tick. Answers carry it as DecisionTick.

field.name: Generation
field.doc: Id of the Tick snapshot (not game time).

field.name: PublishQpc
field.doc: QueryPerformanceCounter when the tick was published.

field.name: EventCount
field.doc: Rows of Events in use, oldest first.

field.name: LastEventSequence
field.doc: Sequence of the newest event of the match up to this tick (0 = none yet).

field.name: ObjectiveCount
field.doc: Rows of Objectives in use.

field.name: StandCount
field.doc: Rows of Stands in use.

field.name: WeaponCount
field.doc: Rows of Weapons in use.

field.name: ProjectileCount
field.doc: Rows of Projectiles in use.

field.name: MapId
field.doc: MapId of the scnr tag of the loaded map, engine id. 0 while no map.

field.name: ExplosiveCount
field.doc: Rows of Explosives in use.

field.name: LiftCount
field.doc: Rows of Lifts in use.

struct.name: BridgeMatch
struct.doc: State of the match (Environment Match, D103).

field.name: GameTick
field.doc: Ticks since the start of the match (60 per second). Does not restart between rounds.

field.name: PlayerScores
field.doc: Score of each player, by player table index.

field.name: RoundIndex
field.doc: Round of the match, from 0.

field.name: TeamRoundScores
field.doc: Score of each team in the current round, by team.

field.name: TeamTotalScores
field.doc: Score of each team added up over the match, by team.

field.name: RoundClockTicks
field.doc: Ticks the round has been played: with a time limit the limit minus the ticks left, without one the stopwatch. Frozen when the round ends, 0 when not known.

field.name: RoundTicksRemaining
field.doc: Ticks left in the round, 0 once it ran out, -1 when the round has no time limit.

field.name: RoundTimeLimitTicks
field.doc: Time limit of a round in ticks, 0 for none.

field.name: RoundLimit
field.doc: Limit of rounds of the game variant, as stored.

field.name: ScoreToWin
field.doc: Score a team (a player in free for all) needs to win, as stored; 0 for none or not known.

field.name: RespawnTimeTicks
field.doc: Respawn time of the game variant in ticks, 0 when not known.

field.name: SuddenDeathTicks
field.doc: Sudden death duration in ticks, -1 for indefinite, 0 when not known.

field.name: GracePeriodTicks
field.doc: Grace period of the game variant in ticks.

field.name: PowerupDurationTicks
field.doc: Duration of the red, blue and yellow powerups of the game variant in ticks.

field.name: LivesPerRound
field.doc: Lives of each player per round, 0 for unlimited.

field.name: TeamLivesPerRound
field.doc: Lives of each team per round, 0 for unlimited.

field.name: RoundsToWin
field.doc: Rounds a team needs to win the match, as stored.

struct.name: BridgeEvent
struct.doc: One event of the engine (Environment Events, D104). Kind and Key: Semantic.xml (Event, eventkeys).

field.name: Sequence
field.doc: From 1 in each match, without gaps. Artemis numbers the events of the log, the ones it generates included.

field.name: EngineSequence
field.doc: Sequence the engine gave the event in its own ring, 0 in the events Artemis generates (flags).

struct.name: BridgePlayerTraits
struct.doc: Traits the engine applies to a player in this tick (Blam.Layout PlayerTraits, D262): already composed with the carried objective, the powerups and the respawn traits. Multipliers are 1.0 for 100%. A raw index outside its table reads NaN (floats), 0 (bools) or Unknown (enums).

field.name: DamageResistance
field.doc: Infinity when invulnerable.

field.name: DamageMultiplier
field.doc: Weapon damage. Infinity for instant kill.

field.name: MeleeMultiplier
field.doc: Infinity for instant kill.

field.name: JumpHeight
field.doc: Multiplier of the stored percentage (150% reads 1.5).

field.name: RadarRange
field.doc: Motion tracker range in meters, not a multiplier.

field.name: HeadshotImmune
field.doc: 0 no, 1 yes.

field.name: AssassinationImmune
field.doc: 0 no, 1 yes.

field.name: CannotDieFromDamage
field.doc: 0 no, 1 yes.

field.name: GrenadeRegen
field.doc: 0 no, 1 yes.

field.name: WeaponPickup
field.doc: 0 no, 1 yes.

field.name: AbilitiesDropOnDeath
field.doc: 0 no, 1 yes.

field.name: InfiniteAbilities
field.doc: 0 no, 1 yes.

field.name: FragGrenades
field.doc: Grenades the player starts with, 255 for the map default.

field.name: PlasmaGrenades
field.doc: Grenades the player starts with, 255 for the map default.

field.name: ActiveCamo
field.doc: Raw setting, 1 off to 5 best.

field.name: PrimaryWeapon
field.doc: Raw index of the weapon table of the game variant editor, -1 none, 0 the first one.

field.name: SecondaryWeapon
field.doc: Raw index of the weapon table of the game variant editor, -1 none.

field.name: Ability
field.doc: Raw index of the armor ability table of the game variant editor, -1 none, 0 sprint.

struct.name: BridgePlayer
struct.doc: One player of the Tick (Environment Players), without its name.

field.name: RespawnTicks
field.doc: Ticks left until the player respawns, 0 while alive (player +0x1BC).

field.name: PowerupTicks
field.doc: Ticks left of the active custom powerup counting this one, 0 when Powerup is None (D263).

field.name: LocalIndex
field.doc: Split-screen index, 0xFF when not local.

field.name: Powerup
field.doc: Custom powerup the engine applies: 0 none, 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow. Also without Body (the engine clears it on death).

field.name: HasBody
field.doc: 0: the fields from Aim on are zero.

field.name: Ground
field.doc: Zero in the air and without Body. A contact that cuts for 1 or 2 ticks keeps the last ground.

field.name: IsGrounded
field.doc: 1 with contact or in the 2 ticks of a cut that was not a jump, 0 attached and in the air.

field.name: IsCrouching
field.doc: CrouchFraction >= 0.5.

field.name: Shield
field.doc: NaN without shield.

field.name: TicksSinceDamage
field.doc: NoHandle (0xFFFFFFFF) when unknown.

field.name: AirborneTicks
field.doc: Ticks without contact in a row, 0 with contact or attached.

field.name: GroundObject
field.doc: Object under the feet when Ground is Object, NoHandle otherwise (the last valid one when the engine drops it).

field.name: CrouchFraction
field.doc: 0 standing to 1 crouched.

field.name: OwnVelocity
field.doc: Velocity relative to the object under the feet, or the biped's own.

field.name: Traits
field.doc: Active traits of the player, also while dead (player +0x328).

field.name: AppliedDecision
field.doc: DecisionTick of the bridge action the engine applied to this player up to this tick (0 = none).

struct.name: BridgeEntity
struct.doc: One live object of the Tick (Environment Entities).

field.name: Vitality
field.doc: NaN without vitality.

struct.name: BridgeObjective
struct.doc: One flag of a capture game (Perception ObjectiveDetail). One struct per kind, and not one block with a Kind: a stand has three fields and a flag ten, so a shared block would carry seven zero fields per stand.

field.name: Handle
field.doc: Object handle of the flag. The engine recreates the flag on reset, return and capture, so it changes: BaseTeam identifies the flag.

field.name: CarrierPlayer
field.doc: Player handle of the carrier, NoHandle when none or when the carrier has no player.

field.name: CarrierBiped
field.doc: Biped handle of the carrier, NoHandle when none.

field.name: HomeStand
field.doc: Handle of the stand with the same BaseTeam, NoHandle when none.

field.name: ResetTicks
field.doc: Ticks left to reset a dropped flag, rounded up. 0 when it is not dropped or the engine has no timer for it.

field.name: BaseTeam
field.doc: Team of the placement in the map variant. It never changes.

field.name: OwnerTeam
field.doc: Team that plays the side of the flag in this round. Neutral when the side is not in use.

field.name: IsResetRunning
field.doc: 1 when the reset timer of a dropped flag is counting down.

field.name: AlliesInZone
field.doc: Live bipeds of players of the OwnerTeam inside the zone of the flag.

struct.name: BridgeStand
struct.doc: One flag stand of a capture game (Perception StandDetail).

field.name: OwnerTeam
field.doc: Team that plays the side of the stand in this round.

struct.name: BridgeMagazine
struct.doc: Ammo of one magazine of a weapon.

field.name: Loaded
field.doc: Rounds in the weapon, ready to fire.

field.name: Reserve
field.doc: Rounds carried outside the weapon.

struct.name: BridgeWeapon
struct.doc: One live weapon (Perception WeaponDetail): in a hand, on the floor or mounted. The pose, the holder and the team are in its entity.

field.name: TrackedObject
field.doc: Object the weapon tracks, NoHandle when it tracks nothing.

field.name: Energy
field.doc: Energy left, 0 to 1, on an energy weapon. NaN on the others.

field.name: Heat
field.doc: 0 to 1.

field.name: ChargeFraction
field.doc: Progress of the charge, 0 to 1. NaN when no trigger of the tag charges.

field.name: Magazines
field.doc: Only the first MagazineCount are meaningful.

field.name: MagazineCount
field.doc: Magazines of the tag that hold rounds, 0 to 2.

field.name: IsEnergyWeapon
field.doc: 1 when the tag has no magazine with rounds.

field.name: IsOverheated
field.doc: 1 from the overheat until the weapon can fire again, whatever the heat says.

field.name: ChargeState
field.doc: Stage of the charged fire mode of trigger 0.

field.name: IsLocked
field.doc: 1 when the tracked object is locked.

field.name: CanFireNow
field.doc: 1 when the weapon is not busy, not overheated and has energy or a loaded round. Does not cover the trigger, the holder or a melee.

struct.name: BridgeProjectile
struct.doc: One live projectile (Perception ProjectileDetail). The pose and the team are in its entity.

field.name: OwnerPlayer
field.doc: Player that fired it, NoHandle when none.

field.name: OwnerBiped
field.doc: Biped that fired it, NoHandle when none.

field.name: ShooterRoot
field.doc: Root of the shooter's parent chain: the biped on foot, the vehicle when seated.

field.name: StuckTo
field.doc: Object the projectile is stuck to, NoHandle in flight and while InHand.

field.name: StuckNode
field.doc: Node of StuckTo, -1 when it is not stuck.

field.name: InHand
field.doc: 1 while a grenade is still in the hand of its thrower.

struct.name: BridgeExplosive
struct.doc: One live explosive (Perception ExplosiveDetail): the explosion of its tags. The life, the pose and the team are in its entity.

field.name: RadiusMin
field.doc: Full damage up to this distance, world units. 0 when the tags have no explosion.

field.name: RadiusMax
field.doc: No damage past this distance, world units.

field.name: Damage
field.doc: Damage points at the center, before the material of the victim.

struct.name: BridgeLiftStage
struct.doc: One stage of a lift: a phantom type of its physics model that pushes players or bipeds (Perception LiftStage).

field.name: Position
field.doc: Marker of the stage, world space. The origin of the lift when the type has no marker.

field.name: Direction
field.doc: +X of the marker, world space. The up of the lift when the type has no marker.

field.name: Acceleration
field.doc: Along Direction, wu/s^2.

field.name: MaximumVelocity
field.doc: Along Direction, wu/s. A cap: some lifts release the biped before it reaches it.

field.name: AxisAcceleration
field.doc: Toward the axis of the marker, wu/s^2. Centers the biped.

field.name: AxisMaximumVelocity
field.doc: Toward the axis of the marker, wu/s.

field.name: Affects
field.doc: Bits: 1 players, 2 bipeds that are not players, 4 vehicles, 8 items (weapons, equipment, crates).

struct.name: BridgeLift
struct.doc: One live lift (Perception LiftDetail): the stages of its tag and the measured exit of the last biped it pushed. The pose and the team are in its entity.

field.name: StageCount
field.doc: Stages in use, 0 to MaxLiftStages. 0 without definitions or physics model.

field.name: HasExit
field.doc: 1 once a biped has left the push of this lift. ExitTick, ExitBiped and ExitVelocity mean nothing before.

field.name: ExitTick
field.doc: GameTick of the first tick with the biped out of the volume.

field.name: ExitBiped
field.doc: Biped that left, NoHandle without an exit.

field.name: ExitVelocity
field.doc: Linear velocity of the biped at ExitTick, world space, wu/s. The last exit replaces the previous one.

field.name: Stages
field.doc: Only the first StageCount are meaningful, in the order of the tag.

struct.name: BridgeTick
struct.doc: One flattened Tick. Sequence and SequenceEnd are equal and even when the tick is complete.

field.name: Objectives
field.doc: Flags, sorted by BaseTeam then Handle.

field.name: Stands
field.doc: Stands, sorted by BaseTeam then Handle.

field.name: Weapons
field.doc: Live weapons, sorted by Handle.

field.name: Projectiles
field.doc: Live projectiles, sorted by Handle.

field.name: Explosives
field.doc: Live explosives, sorted by Handle.

field.name: Lifts
field.doc: Live lifts, sorted by Handle.

struct.name: BridgeAction
struct.doc: Action of one player for one decision, written by Python (D109, D119).

field.name: PlayerHandle
field.doc: Full handle of the player of the slot (D40). Another handle drops the action.

field.name: Lanes
field.doc: Down bits of the hold lanes (D121).

field.name: DecisionTick
field.doc: ActionTick of the tick this action answers. Written 0 first, then the fields, then the tick.

field.name: Yaw
field.doc: Absolute, radians.

field.name: Pitch
field.doc: Absolute, radians.

struct.name: BridgeRegion
struct.doc: The whole shared memory of one instance.
